[/b][size=4][center][b]A group of strange individuals have been seen setting up camp in Stardew Valley.[/b]
Adds custom NPC characters from Baldur's Gate 3 to Stardew Valley. Hundreds of lines of dialogue, unique schedules, gifting, romance, heart events, and a short questline included![/center][/size]

This mod is a [b][color=#ff0000][size=4]WORK IN PROGRESS![/size][/color][/b] See the articles tab for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2116]a long list of to-dos[/url].

I can't thoroughly test for bugs and compatibility issues so please feel free to let me know of any and I will try my best to fix them.

[size=5][b]Details
[/b][/size][/size][/center]
This mod is not a replacer and adds new full NPCs to Stardew Valley with dialogue, romance, gift tastes, and events.
[color=#e87c2e][size=3][b]Requirements:[/b][/size][/color] SDV 1.6+, SMAPI 4.0.8+, Content Patcher 2.0.6+
[color=#e87c2e][size=3][b]Installation:[/b][/size][/color] Unzip and place into Stardew Valley/Mods folder. Recommend using on a new save or sleeping through a day to fully load all assets.
[color=#e87c2e][size=3][b]Compatibility:[/b][/size][/color]
﻿Works with existing saves, however you may need to sleep and start a new day for all content to load into the game.
﻿Campsite access may conflict with mods that edit Cindersap Forest. Mods that add other NPCs to Stardew Valley may cause overlap/schedule issues.
﻿Patch available for Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE) to fix missing Gale.


[b][color=#00ff00][size=4]Currently Added:[/size][/color][/b]
[size=3]Shadowheart, Wyll, Gale, and Astarion have set up in the Valley!
They have dialogues, gift tastes, romances, 2-heart events, and a mini-questline for you.
Scratch is also checking out the area![/size][b][color=#6aa84f][size=3]
[/size][/color][color=#ff0000][size=3][b][size=4]
Upcoming:[/size][/b][/size][/color][color=#6aa84f][size=3]
[/size][/color][/b]Lae'Zel, Karlach, an Owlbear Cub, and more!
Heart events and minor schedule adjustments.
Festival participation.


For detailed information please check out the Baldur's Valley Wiki in the mod's articles tab, or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2115]click here[/url].[b][u]
